keywords.title: Search keywords
keywords.description: Search terms, typed as in the TikTok search bar (e.g. cytaty motywacyjne). Each keyword is searched separately; all results land in one dataset.

hashtags.title: Hashtags
hashtags.description: Hashtag feeds to scrape, with or without # (e.g. motywacja). Optional.

maxItems.title: Maximum videos in total
maxItems.description: Total cap across all keywords and hashtags.

maxItemsPerQuery.title: Maximum videos per keyword / hashtag
maxItemsPerQuery.description: Cap for a single keyword or hashtag. TikTok usually stops serving search results somewhere between 200 and 500 per query.

sortBy.title: Sort output by
sortBy.description: Order of videos in the dataset (applied after scraping).

maxAgeDays.title: Only videos from the last N days
maxAgeDays.description: Skip videos older than this. Leave empty for no limit.

maxFollowers.title: Maximum creator followers
maxFollowers.description: Keep only creators with at most this many followers. Useful to find small accounts that went viral.

uniqueAuthors.title: One video per creator
uniqueAuthors.description: Keep only the first video of each creator, for creator discovery.

generateReport.title: Generate insights report
generateReport.description: Save an HTML report (REPORT) and a JSON summary (SUMMARY) to the key-value store: top hashtags, best posting hours and weekdays, duration sweet spot, voice-over vs music, top hooks and small creators that went viral.

timezone.title: Time zone for posting-time analysis
timezone.description: IANA time zone used for hour and weekday stats (e.g. Europe/Warsaw).

reportLanguage.title: Report language
reportLanguage.description: Language of the HTML report and the takeaways.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy
proxyConfiguration.description: TikTok blocks datacenter IPs quickly. Residential proxy is strongly recommended; choose the country your audience is in.

sessionCookie.title: TikTok sessionid cookie (optional)
sessionCookie.description: Only if TikTok shows a login wall for search. Value of the sessionid cookie from a logged-in browser. Use a secondary account: scraping can get the account restricted.

maxScrolls.title: Maximum scrolls per page
maxScrolls.description: How many times to scroll a results page to load more videos.
